from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from main import app

client = TestClient(app)


def test_duplicate_item_returns_conflict() -> None:
    response = client.post("/items", json={"name": "Microscope"})
    assert response.status_code == 409
    assert response.json() == {"code": "item_exists", "name": "Microscope"}
